scope: seasonal DJF/JJA, two scenarios, three regions
checks: Complete DJF/JJA season-year coverage and separate zero-mean historical baselines
Published grid-cell bounds span the globe
Every regional weight sum matches its analytic spherical area, including longitude wrap
Independent NumPy regional recomputation agrees with every seasonal anomaly
All seasonal fields have plausible Kelvin values
Independent NumPy polyfit reproduces all 12 default warming rates
Winter and summer have identical matching future years
Slope of seasonal anomaly gap equals difference of seasonal slopes
limitations: Raw month-boundary verification is reported separately in remote_validation.json.
Tests do not establish ensemble uncertainty or statistical significance.
